title: 第2章 不是，你听我解释啊！
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
“路仙瑶！”

    云鹤珏气得整个面部肌肉都在颤抖，牙齿咬得咯咯作响。

    她这么做，就不怕日后他再也不理会她了吗？

    定是她想反其道而行，引他注意的！

    想到这，他心中的怒火消失了些许。

    路仙瑶才不管他是如何想的，见衣服扒不成，转而去扒他的裤子。

    这衣服是一整套的，必须全扒了！

    “路仙瑶，你别太过份，送出去的东西，哪有往回收的道理？”云鹤珏死死拽住裤头不松手。

    她已经扒烂了他的外衣，若真让她扒了自己裤子，那要是被人瞧见了，他颜面何存？

    他也不蠢啊？

    “云鹤珏，你不是挺心高气傲的吗？我送你这些东西的时候，百般推辞不要，现在死死护着做什么？”

    “谁说我护着了？”

    云鹤珏一时羞愧，手上力道松了几分，却被路仙瑶抓住时机，直接把裤子被扒了下来，露出两条白花花大腿！

    偏偏这死女人还对着他的大腿欣赏，“啧啧，要不是你是渣男，我高低也得尝尝在我身下的滋味。”

    他就知道这死女人是故意的！

    平时想方设法博取他的注意不成，现在竟然用上这样的烂招数了？

    云鹤珏哪里被女子这样调戏过？

    一时羞红了脸。

    “路仙瑶，你不要脸！”

    然后，气得跑出去了。

    路仙瑶也不追，反正他衣服坏了，裤子也没了，她不用做什么，这么出去够丢人现眼的了。

    她还不忘冲着他飞身离去的身影喊道：“云鹤珏，你记得把我送你的东西还我啊，你要是不记得也没关系，我回头列个清单，差人给你送过去！”

    他飞得太快了，也不知道有没有听到。

    他有没有听到不重要，重要的是路仙瑶的目的达到了。

    她心满意足地把地上撕了一半的衣服和裤子捡起，想着要如何处理，可抬头，看见门外有一名蓝衣少年，正一脸仿佛看见了什么震惊的表情。

    这是她那九个炉鼎里之一的墨燃。

    他该不会以为她抱着云鹤珏的衣服，是在……

    “不是你想的那样……”

    “主人不用解释，墨燃都知道。”墨燃一脸我懂的表情。
content_en:
"Lu Xianyao!"

    Yun Hejue was so angry that his entire facial muscles were trembling, and his teeth were clenching.

    If she does this, isn't she afraid that he will never pay attention to her again in the future?

    She must be trying to do the opposite and attract his attention!

    Thinking of this, the anger in his heart disappeared a little.

    Lu Xianyao didn't care what he thought. Seeing that she couldn't take off his clothes, she turned to take off his pants.

    This piece of clothing is a complete set, so I have to take it all off!

    "Lu Xianyao, don't go too far. How can there be any reason to recycle the things you gave away?" Yun Hejue held on to his pants tightly and refused to let go.

    She had already torn off his coat. If he really let her take off his pants, what would happen to his face if someone saw him?

    Isn't he stupid?

    "Yun Hejue, aren't you very arrogant? When I gave you these things, I refused in every possible way. Why are you so protective of them now?"

    "Who said I was protecting you?"

    Yun Hejue was ashamed for a moment and loosened his grip a little, but Lu Xianyao seized the opportunity and took off his pants directly, revealing two white thighs!

    But this damn woman was still admiring his thighs, "Tsk, tsk, if you weren't such a scumbag, I would have to taste what it's like to be under me."

    He knew this dead woman did it on purpose!

    You usually try every means to get his attention, but now you are using such a bad trick?

    Where has Yun Hejue ever been molested by a woman like this?

    He blushed for a moment.

    "Lu Xianyao, you are shameless!"

    Then, he ran out in anger.

    Lu Xianyao didn't chase him. Anyway, his clothes were ruined and his pants were gone. She didn't have to do anything. It was embarrassing enough to go out like this.

    She did not forget to shout at his flying figure: "Yun Hejue, please remember to return the things I gave you. It doesn't matter if you don't remember. I will make a list later and send someone to deliver it to you!"

    He was flying too fast, and I don't know if he heard it.

    It doesn't matter whether he heard it or not. What matters is that Lu Xianyao's goal was achieved.

    Satisfied, she picked up the half-torn clothes and pants on the ground and thought about what to do with them. But when she looked up, she saw a young man in blue outside the door, with a shocked expression on his face as if he had seen something.

    This is the burning of one of her nine furnaces.

    Could he think that she was holding Yun Hejue's clothes...

    "It's not what you think..."

    "Master, there is no need to explain, Mo Ran knows it." Mo Ran had an expression on his face that said I understand.
title_en: Chapter 2 No, listen to my explanation!
